description: MCP interface for the Edge Computing topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating edge deployment configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for edge-governed implementation and extraction-readiness guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect an Edge Computing topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, deployment targets, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Edge Computing configuration file

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate an Edge Computing configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Edge Computing configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Edge Computing Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Edge Computing, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Edge Computing Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Edge Computing: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Edge Computing topology constraints, offline resilience, and resource limits.

prompts.name: extraction-readiness-review
prompts.description: Evaluates whether a modular monolith module is ready for extraction into a distributed edge deployment, checking coupling, ownership, and contract boundaries.
